PC: Evaluate and perform the primary survey with reassessments throughout the simulation case
Obtain emergent diagnostic tests for altered mental status including glucose, electrolytes, blood gas.
Recognize and treat widened QRS complex of unknown etiology with sodium bicarbonate
Recognize rhythm change to ventricular tachycardia (VT) and loss of pulses
Follow PALS algorithm for treatment of pulses VT including high-quality CPR and timely defibrillation
Identify ventilatory failure and manage with advanced airway support
Address hemodynamic instability after return of spontaneous circulation
MK: Recognize history concerning for possible ingestion
SBP: PICU, Cardiac ICU, and/or cardiology and toxicology services are consulted.
A code cart and defibrillator with hands-free pads are requested in anticipation of potential cardiac decompensation.
Next steps for treatment such as intra-lipids or extra-corporeal membrane oxygenation are considered as appropriate
